# Acceptance Checklist Template

Use this checklist when CEO and reviewer decide whether an issue is ready for acceptance.

## Issue Summary

- Issue ID:
- Title:
- Worker:
- Reviewer:
- Date reviewed:
- Session mode used:

## Acceptance Gate

Mark each item as `pass`, `fail`, or `defer with note`.

### Goal Completion
- [ ] Objective matches issue contract
- [ ] In-scope deliverables are present
- [ ] Out-of-scope items did not silently expand the task

### Artifact Completeness
- [ ] All required files / reports / comments exist
- [ ] Artifact paths are explicit
- [ ] Final result is readable without guessing missing context

### Verification Quality
- [ ] Verification command or evidence is present
- [ ] Claimed result matches verification output
- [ ] Reviewer checked the highest-risk claim

### Continuity Hygiene
- [ ] Session-mode choice still makes sense in hindsight
- [ ] Continuity brief was updated if work spanned multiple passes
- [ ] Issue thread is legible without relying on local-only notes

### Risk / Rework Threshold
- [ ] No unresolved blocker is hidden inside the deliverable
- [ ] Residual risk is named, not implied
- [ ] Any deferred work is explicitly listed

## Decision

- Final outcome: `accept | rework | cancel | split follow-up`
- CEO comment summary:
- Reviewer note:
- Follow-up issue needed:
- If deferred, why acceptance is still acceptable:
